title: Find the Winning Player in Coin Game
summary: Given positive integers x and y representing the number of coins valued at 75 and 10 respectively, determine which player wins the game where each turn requires picking coins summing to 115.
statement: Given positive integers x and y representing the number of coins valued at 75 and 10 respectively, determine which player wins the game where each turn requires picking coins summing to 115. If a player cannot pick such coins, they lose. Both players play optimally.
constraints: Each turn removes one 75-value coin and four 10-value coins, totaling 115.
Alice moves first and players alternate until the required coins are unavailable.
Return Alice if she makes the last move, otherwise Bob.
hints: Every legal move consumes the same fixed resources, so the total move count is predetermined.
At most x moves use 75-value coins and at most floor(y/4) use 10-value coins.
Take their minimum and inspect its parity.
Players alternate from Alice, so an odd number of moves ends with Alice and an even number with Bob.
editorial: Players alternate from Alice, so an odd number of moves ends with Alice and an even number with Bob.

tests.explanation: Only one complete move is possible, so Alice wins.
Two moves are possible, so Bob makes the last move.
